detail: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature.

title: Cast Phantom Steed
detail: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

title: Cast Phoenix Flames
detail: You immolate yourself, consuming your body in a searing cloud of holy flames.

title: Cast Pillar of Force
detail: You swiftly stomp your foot, conjuring a pillar of wood or stone that thrusts out from underneath your feet and towards a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Planar Ally
detail: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid.

title: Cast Planar Binding
detail: With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend to your service.

title: Cast Plane Shift
detail: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

title: Cast Plant Growth
detail: This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area.

title: Cast Plummet
detail: You conjure an enormous glowing force, which wraps around a flying creature within range, and attempt to pull it out of the air.

title: Cast Pogmo's Pot
detail: You summon a cast iron pot in an unoccupied space on the ground within range.

title: Cast Poison Spray
detail: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm.

title: Cast Polychromatic Bubble
detail: You create a shimmering, multicolored bubble around a Large or smaller creature or an object within range.

title: Cast Polymorph
detail: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form.

title: Cast Portho's Portal
detail: You conjure a portal or doorway that links an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location in the mortal or fey realms—such as Midgard, the Shadow Realm, or the Summer Lands—that you have stood.

title: Cast Power Word Heal
detail: A wave of healing energy washes over the creature you touch.

title: Cast Power Word Kill
detail: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly.

title: Cast Power Word Pain
detail: You speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Power Word Stun
detail: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded.

title: Cast Pratfall
detail: You cause a small bit of bad luck to befall a creature, making it look humorously foolish.

title: Cast Prayer of Healing
detail: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

title: Cast Prestidigitation
detail: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

title: Cast Primal Savagery
detail: You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen, ready to deliver a corrosive attack.

title: Cast Primordial Ward
detail: You have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Prismatic Spray
detail: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand.

title: Cast Prismatic Wall
detail: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Produce Flame
detail: A flickering flame appears in your hand.

title: Cast Programmed Illusion
detail: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs.

title: Cast Project Image
detail: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Protection from Energy
detail: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

title: Cast Protection from Evil and Good
detail: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

title: Cast Protection from Poison
detail: You touch a creature.

title: Cast Psychic Scream
detail: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Purge Contamination
detail: You apply alchemical fluids or holy water to a contaminated humanoid creature while reciting an exacting magical chant that expels eldritch contaminants from the target's body.

title: Cast Purify Food and Drink
detail: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

title: Cast Pyrotechnics
detail: Choose an area of nonmagical flame that you can see and that fits within a 5-foot cube within range.

title: Cast Radiant Beacon
detail: A pillar of light falls from the air, filling the square you are in and the area within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Rageful Nimbus
detail: Choose a creature within range, which can be yourself.

title: Cast Raise Dead
detail: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days.

title: Cast Rary's Telepathic Bond
detail: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration.

title: Cast Raulothim's Psychic Lance
detail: You unleash a shimmering lance of psychic power from your forehead at a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Ray of Contamination
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Ray of Enfeeblement
detail: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Ray of Frost
detail: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Ray of Sickness
detail: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Regenerate
detail: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability.

title: Cast Reincarnate
detail: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid.

title: Cast Remove Curse
detail: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end.

title: Cast Resilient Friendship
detail: You magically assist a creature within range, granting it the benefits of the Help action.

title: Cast Resistance
detail: You touch one willing creature.

title: Cast Resurrection
detail: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead.

title: Cast Retrieve
detail: You cause an object within range that isn't being worn or carried to fly to your open hand.

title: Cast Reverse Gravity
detail: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Revivify
detail: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute.

title: Cast Ride the Lightning
detail: You transform yourself into a bolt of lightning and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

title: Cast Ride the Rifts
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Rime's Binding Ice
detail: A burst of cold energy emanates from you in a 30-foot cone.

title: Cast Root Grab
detail: You cause roots to reach out and grasp at the creature that provoked the opportunity attack, hindering its movement.

title: Cast Rope Trick
detail: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long.

title: Cast Sacrament of the Falling Fire
detail: This spell may only be cast in an area covered by the Deep Haze.

title: Cast Sacred Flame
detail: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Sanctuary
detail: You ward a creature within range against attack.

title: Cast Sand Structure
detail: A wall of sand that is 5 feet tall, 5 feet wide, and 1 foot thick materializes from the ground up in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Scatter
detail: The air quivers around up to five creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Scorching Ray
detail: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range.

title: Cast Scrying
detail: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you.

title: Cast Searing Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity, and the attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage to the target and causes the target to ignite in flames.

title: Cast Searing Sun
detail: This spell intensifies the light and heat of the sun, so that it burns exposed flesh.

title: Cast See Invisibility
detail: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.

title: Cast Seeming
detail: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range.

title: Cast Sending
detail: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar.

title: Cast Sequester
detail: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration.

title: Cast Shadow Adaptation
detail: Your flesh and clothing pale and become faded as your body takes on a tiny fragment of the Shadow Realm.

title: Cast Shadow Armor
detail: You can siphon energy from the Plane of Shadow to protect yourself from an immediate threat.

title: Cast Shadow Bite
detail: You create a momentary needle of cold, sharp pain in a creature within range.

title: Cast Shadow Blade
detail: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand.

title: Cast Shadow Blindness
detail: You make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch that has darkvision as an innate ability; on a hit, the target's darkvision is negated until the spell ends.

title: Cast Shadow Gateway
detail: By drawing a circle of black chalk up to 15 feet in diameter and chanting for one minute during the casting time, you open a portal directly into the Plane of Shadow.

title: Cast Shadow Hands
detail: A freezing blast of shadow explodes out from you in a 10-foot cone.

title: Cast Shadow of Moil
detail: Flame-like shadows wreathe your body until the spell ends, causing you to become heavily obscured to others.

title: Cast Shadow Portal
detail: You create a door in the nearest wall, cliff, tree, or similar structure.

title: Cast Shadow Puppets
detail: You animate the shadow of a creature within range, causing it to attack that creature.

title: Cast Shadow Step
detail: You can open a temporary portal between two darkened areas, allowing you to move from one such area to another without crossing the intervening space.

title: Cast Shadow Tendrils
detail: Writhing ribbons of quasi-real darkness extend from your hand.

title: Cast Shadow Trove
detail: You paint a small door approximately 2 feet square on a hard surface to create a portal into the void of space.

title: Cast Shape Plants
detail: You call upon gentle natural magics to alter the growth of plants.

title: Cast Shape Water
detail: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

title: Cast Shapechange
detail: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration.

title: Cast Shared Vision
detail: You target a willing creature that is familiar to you and within range.

title: Cast Shatter
detail: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range.

title: Cast Shield
detail: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.

title: Cast Shield of Faith
detail: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

title: Cast Shillelagh
detail: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power.

title: Cast Shocking Grasp
detail: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch.

title: Cast Sickening Radiance
detail: Dim, greenish light spreads within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Silence
detail: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Silent Image
detail: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.

title: Cast Silvery Barbs
detail: You magically distract the triggering creature and turn its momentary uncertainty into encouragement for another creature.

title: Cast Simulacrum
detail: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell.

title: Cast Siphon Contamination
detail: This demanding spell transfers contamination from one creature to another.

title: Cast Skill Empowerment
detail: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent.

title: Cast Skywrite
detail: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see.

title: Cast Sleep
detail: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber.

title: Cast Sleet Storm
detail: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Slither
detail: You momentarily become a shadow (a humanoid-shaped absence of light, not the Undead creature of that name).

title: Cast Slow
detail: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range.

title: Cast Snare
detail: As you cast this spell, you use the rope to create a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground or the floor.

title: Cast Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
detail: A flurry of magic snowballs erupts from a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Soul Cage
detail: This spell snatches the soul of a humanoid as it dies and traps it inside the tiny cage you use for the material component.

title: Cast Spare the Dying
detail: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points.

title: Cast Speak with Animals
detail: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

title: Cast Speak with Dead
detail: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose.

title: Cast Speak with Plants
detail: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

title: Cast Spell Signature
detail: As you cast the spell you draw out the potent scents trapped within all magic.

title: Cast Spider Climb
detail: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.

title: Cast Spider Song
detail: You sing a piping tune and conjure shadows into enormous, ever-growing webs.

title: Cast Spike Growth
detail: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns.

title: Cast Spiny Shield
detail: An ethereal barrier of spikes, made of magical force, interposes itself between you and an attacker.

title: Cast Spirit Guardians
detail: You call forth spirits to protect you.

title: Cast Spirit of Death
detail: You call forth a spirit that embodies death.

title: Cast Spirit Shroud
detail: You call forth spirits of the dead, which flit around you for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Spirit Swarm
detail: You invite spirits to take their revenge upon a target.

title: Cast Spiritual Weapon
detail: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again.

title: Cast Spray of Cards
detail: You spray a 15-foot cone of spectral cards.

title: Cast Sprout Foliage
detail: You sprout and rapidly grow a lush leafy foliage that covers the entirety of your body.

title: Cast Staggering Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon pierces both body and mind, and the attack deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage to the target.

title: Cast Steel Wind Strike
detail: You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind.

title: Cast Stellar Bodies
detail: You create two small stars that orbit you.

title: Cast Stinking Cloud
detail: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Stone Shape
detail: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose.

title: Cast Stoneskin
detail: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone.

title: Cast Storm Door
detail: Crackling with lightning, you teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

title: Cast Storm of Vengeance
detail: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet.

title: Cast Storm Sphere
detail: A 20-foot-radius sphere of whirling air springs into existence, centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Storm Stallion
detail: Choose a 5-foot-cube space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Submerge
detail: This spell creates a magical link between a body of water within range and another body of water, at any location within 500 miles, on the same plane of existence.

title: Cast Suffocate
detail: You create a pair of grasping hands made from invisible forces.

title: Cast Suggestion
detail: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you.

title: Cast Summon Aberration
detail: You call forth an aberrant spirit.

title: Cast Summon Beast
detail: You call forth a bestial spirit.

title: Cast Summon Celestial
detail: You call forth a celestial spirit.

title: Cast Summon Construct
detail: You call forth the spirit of a construct.

title: Cast Summon Draconic Spirit
detail: You call forth a draconic spirit.

title: Cast Summon Elemental
detail: You call forth an elemental spirit.

title: Cast Summon Fey
detail: You call forth a fey spirit.

title: Cast Summon Fiend
detail: You call forth a fiendish spirit.

title: Cast Summon Greater Demon
detail: You utter foul words, summoning one demon from the chaos of the Abyss.

title: Cast Summon Jack-o'-lantern
detail: A giant jack-o'-lantern rapidly grows around up to four Medium or smaller creatures or one Large creature within a 5-foot radius centered on a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Summon Lesser Demons
detail: You utter foul words, summoning demons from the chaos of the Abyss.

title: Cast Summon Shadowspawn
detail: You call forth a shadowy spirit.

title: Cast Summon Undead
detail: You call forth an undead spirit.

title: Cast Summon Vehicle
detail: You summon a bicycle or moving machine in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Sunbeam
detail: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line.

title: Cast Sunburst
detail: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Supernal Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon shatters the ambient magic surrounding the creature, and the attack deals an extra 4d6 force damage.

title: Cast Swallow Magic
detail: You chomp down on the threads of magic left in the air after the triggering spell fails to affect you, swallowing the now latent magic and gaining one of the following effects of your choice:You regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modif...

title: Cast Swift Quiver
detail: You transmute your quiver so it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand when you reach for it.

title: Cast Switched Form
detail: This spell allows you to change the appearance of two humanoids that you can see within range.

title: Cast Sword Burst
detail: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you.

title: Cast Symbol
detail: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest).

title: Cast Synaptic Static
detail: You choose a point within range and cause psychic energy to explode there.

title: Cast Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast
detail: You sanctify a meal in an extravagant show of thrown spices and twirling dance.

title: Cast Tasha's Caustic Brew
detail: A stream of acid emanates from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose.

title: Cast Tasha's Hideous Laughter
detail: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it.

title: Cast Tasha's Mind Whip
detail: You psychically lash out at one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
detail: Uttering an incantation, you draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself.

title: Cast Task
detail: With a flick of your wrist, you magically complete a small and simple task, such as flipping a book page, buttering bread, or heating a cup of tea, without any physical interaction.

title: Cast Telekinesis
detail: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought.

title: Cast Telepathy
detail: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar.

title: Cast Teleport
detail: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

title: Cast Teleportation Circle
detail: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you.

title: Cast Temple of the Gods
detail: You cause a temple to shimmer into existence on ground you can see within range.

title: Cast Tenser's Floating Disk
detail: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Tenser's Transformation
detail: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess fueled by magic.

title: Cast Thaumaturgy
detail: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

title: Cast Thorn Whip
detail: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range.

title: Cast Thunder Step
detail: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within range.

title: Cast Thunderclap
detail: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away.

title: Cast Thunderous Smite
detail: The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you, and the attack deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage to the target.

title: Cast Thunderwave
detail: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you.

title: Cast Tidal Wave
detail: You conjure up a wave of water that crashes down on an area within range.

title: Cast Time Stop
detail: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

title: Cast Tiny Servant
detail: You touch one Tiny, nonmagical object that isn't attached to another object or a surface and isn't being carried by another creature.

title: Cast Toll the Dead
detail: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment.

title: Cast Tongues
detail: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears.

title: Cast Transmute Rock
detail: You choose an area of stone or mud that you can see that fits within a 40-foot cube and is within range, and choose one of the following effects.

title: Cast Transparency
detail: You temporarily become invisible to stop yourself from being discovered by the triggering creature.

title: Cast Transport via Plants
detail: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence.

title: Cast Tree Stride
detail: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet.

title: Cast True Polymorph
detail: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range.

title: Cast True Resurrection
detail: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age.

title: Cast True Seeing
detail: This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are.

title: Cast True Strike
detail: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range.

title: Cast Tsunami
detail: A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Ugly Duckling
detail: One creature of your choice within range must make a Charisma saving throw.

title: Cast Umbral Storm
detail: You create a channel to a region of the Plane of Shadow that is inimical to life and order.

title: Cast Unseen Servant
detail: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends.

title: Cast Vampiric Touch
detail: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds.

title: Cast Vegetable Blade
detail: A lush bunch of vegetable fronds suddenly springs from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range.

title: Cast Veil of Dusk
detail: You incant towards a creature, cloaking them in a shadowy veil of darkness and silence.

title: Cast Vengeful Blade
detail: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Vicious Mockery
detail: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Vitriolic Sphere
detail: You point at a location within range, and a glowing 1-foot-diameter ball of emerald acid streaks there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere.

title: Cast Void Strike
detail: With a short phrase of void speech, you gather writhing darkness around your hand.

title: Cast Vortex Warp
detail: You magically twist space around another creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Wall of Death
detail: You create a wall of necrotic energy on a surface within range.

title: Cast Wall of Fire
detail: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range.

title: Cast Wall of Force
detail: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Wall of Ice
detail: You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range.

title: Cast Wall of Light
detail: A shimmering wall of bright light appears at a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Wall of Sand
detail: You create a wall of swirling sand on the ground at a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Wall of Stone
detail: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Wall of Thorns
detail: You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns.

title: Cast Wall of Water
detail: You create a wall of water on the ground at a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Warding Bond
detail: This spell wards a willing creature you touch and creates a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends.

title: Cast Warding Wind
detail: A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you.

title: Cast Warp Bolt
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Warp Sense
detail: For the duration, you sense the presence of portals, even inactive ones, within 30 feet of yourself.

title: Cast Water Breathing
detail: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends.

title: Cast Water Bullet
detail: You create a sphere of swirling water that spins rapidly in your hand or mouth before you hurl it at a creature within range.

title: Cast Water Walk
detail: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).

title: Cast Watery Sphere
detail: You conjure up a sphere of water with a 5-foot radius at a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Web
detail: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range.

title: Cast Weird
detail: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them.

title: Cast Whelm Weapon
detail: Up to three weapons of your choice that you can see within range become enveloped by water.

title: Cast Whirlwind
detail: A whirlwind howls down to a point that you can see on the ground within range.

title: Cast Wind Sprint
detail: A turning tempest wind lifts you up and carries you to a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Wind Walk
detail: You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous form for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud.

title: Cast Wind Wall
detail: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Wish
detail: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast.

title: Cast Witch Bolt
detail: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target.

title: Cast Wither and Bloom
detail: You invoke both death and life upon a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Word of Misfortune
detail: You hiss a word of void speech.

title: Cast Word of Radiance
detail: You utter a divine word, and burning radiance erupts from you.

title: Cast Word of Recall
detail: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary.

title: Cast Wrack
detail: Choose a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Wrath of Nature
detail: You call out to the spirits of nature to rouse them against your enemies.

title: Cast Wrathful Smite
detail: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage.

title: Cast Zephyr Strike
detail: You move like the wind.

title: Cast Zone of Truth
detail: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range.

title: Celestial Resilience
detail: Starting at 10th level, you gain temporary hit points whenever you finish a short or long rest.

detail: While incense is burning in this censer, you can use an action to speak the censer's command word and summon an air elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell.

detail: A constellation of a life-giving goblet appears on you.

title: Chancellor's Crest
detail: While wearing this amulet, you can read all writing, and speak and understand any language.

title: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to create simple items.

title: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
detail: 2nd-level Peace Domain feature You can use your Channel Divinity to make your very presence a soothing balm.

title: Channel Divinity: Blessing of the Full Moon
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to infuse your allies with bestial power.

title: Channel Divinity: Blood Puppet
detail: Starting at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to briefly control a creature's actions—whether that creature is living or dead.

title: Channel Divinity: Blood Puppet (17th Level)
detail: At 17th level, you can use this feature to target a Huge or smaller creature or corpse.

title: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to charm animals and plants.

title: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
detail: Starting at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to vanish.

title: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
detail: Starting at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to vanish.

title: Channel Divinity: Consuming Fervor
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to channel your zeal into unchecked ferocity.

title: Channel Divinity: Crimson Bond
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to form a supernatural bond with a creature you can see, or with a creature for which you possess a blood sample.

title: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to wield the power of the storm with unchecked ferocity.

title: Channel Divinity: Feat of Strength
detail: At 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to enhance your physical might.

title: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy.

title: Channel Divinity: Harness Divine Power
detail: 2nd-level cleric optional class features You can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to fuel your spells.

title: Channel Divinity: Harness Divine Power
detail: 3rd-level paladin optional class features You can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to fuel your spells.

title: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity

title: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to create an illusory duplicate of yourself.

title: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to tap into a divine well of knowledge.

title: Channel Divinity: Mind of Two Moons
detail: Starting at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to invoke the twofold arcana of Exandria's moons.

title: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to exert an intimidating presence over others.

title: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to mark another creature's life force for termination.

title: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured.

title: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured.

title: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to harness sunlight, banishing darkness and dealing radiant damage to your foes.

title: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
detail: At 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to read a creature's thoughts.

title: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
detail: Starting at 2nd level, the cleric can use Channel Divinity to destroy another creature's life force by touch.

title: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
detail: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead.

title: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
detail: 2nd-level Twilight Domain feature You can use your Channel Divinity to refresh your allies with soothing twilight.

title: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
detail: At 6th level, when a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to the roll, using your Channel Divinity.

title: Chaos Distortion
detail: Chaos Distortion (Action, 1/day): Unleash a pulse of chaotic energy in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. All affected enemies suffer disadvantage on their next attack rolls.

title: Charged Rapier
detail: This blade snaps and crackles with electrical power as it's waved through the air.

title: Charger
detail: When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature.

title: Charm of Plant Command
detail: This fist-sized charm is made from a bundle of dried plant stems wrapped in silver thread.

title: Charred Wand of Magic Missiles
detail: This wand has 7 charges.

title: Chime of Exile
detail: This silver chime is engraved with delicate magic sigils.

title: Chime of Opening
detail: This hollow metal tube measures about 1 foot long and weighs 1 pound.

title: Chimeric Collar
detail: This magic collar has three sections of sculpted metal bound by a strip of leather, with each section representing the head of a dragon, lion, and ram.

title: Chitinous Club of c'Naazo
detail: Once a tentacle of the monstrosity c'Naazo, this massive club made of segmented chitin is suffused with glowing, phosphorescent green magic and emits an unpleasant odor when wielded.

title: Chromatic Obsidian Greataxe
detail: This prismatic greataxe is made using chromatic obsidian, a dazzling type of stone found where several Elemental Planes meet.

title: Chromatic Rose
detail: This magic rose comes in one of five colors, as noted in the Chromatic Roses table.

title: Chronal Shift
detail: 2nd-level Chronurgy Magic feature You can magically exert limited control over the flow of time around a creature.

title: Chronal Sphere
detail: This brass sphere is roughly fist-sized and weighs 1 pound.

title: Chronolometer
detail: While attuned to this device, you have a +1 bonus to Intelligence saving throws.

title: Chronomancer's Eyepiece
detail: This singular lens lets you faintly see and command the flow of time around a target.

title: Circle Forms
detail: The rites of your circle grant you the ability to transform into more dangerous animal forms.

title: Circle of Mortality
detail: At 1st level, you gain the ability to manipulate the line between life and death.

title: Circle Spells
detail: 2nd-level Circle of Wildfire feature You have formed a bond with a wildfire spirit, a primal being of creation and destruction.

title: Circlet of Barbed Vision (Awakened)
detail: When you don this circlet of gnarled onyx, black barbs dig into your head, imparting power to you as the circlet twists your appearance to amuse The Spider Queen.

title: Circlet of Barbed Vision (Dormant)
detail: When you don this circlet of gnarled onyx, black barbs dig into your head, imparting power to you as the circlet twists your appearance to amuse The Spider Queen.

title: Circlet of Barbed Vision (Exalted)
detail: When you don this circlet of gnarled onyx, black barbs dig into your head, imparting power to you as the circlet twists your appearance to amuse The Spider Queen.

title: Circlet of Blasting
detail: While wearing this circlet, you can use an action to cast the scorching ray spell with it.

title: Circlet of the Sharpened Mind
detail: This iron circlet has a magical pearl at its center and can hold up to 4 gemstones.

title: Clarity of Catha
detail: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you learn to shine light upon the mind's most dire moments, shielding those you protect.

title: Claw of the Wyrm Rune
detail: This dragon's claw has been covered with a coat of molten silver, upon which has been inscribed the wyrm (dragon) rune.

title: Claymore of Grass
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Claymore of Throne's Command
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Claymore of Verdict
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Claymore of Wounding
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Cleaning Cube
detail: This Tiny, sentient piece of an enchanted gelatinous cube is harmlessly soapy, instead of acidic, and enjoys cleaning the surfaces it travels across.

title: Cleansing Stone
detail: A cleansing stone is a sphere 1 foot in diameter, engraved with mystic sigils.

title: Cleansing Touch
detail: Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch.

title: Climber's Kit
detail: A climber's kit includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness.

title: Cloak of Arachnida
detail: This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint silvery threads.

title: Cloak of Billowing
detail: While wearing this cloak, you can use a bonus action to make it billow dramatically.

title: Cloak of Many Fashions
detail: While wearing this cloak, you can use a bonus action to change the style, color, and apparent quality of the garment.

title: Cloak of Shadows
detail: By 11th level, you have learned to become one with the shadows.

title: Cloak of Splendor
detail: This cloak is made of fine ermine and often embellished with fasteners or trimmed with gold or embroidered orange candles, suns, or similar symbols.

title: Cloche of Surprise Treats
detail: This magic silver cloche covers a large dinner platter.

title: Clockwork Cavalcade
detail: 18th-level Clockwork Soul feature You summon spirits of order to expunge disorder around you.

title: Clockwork Earwig
detail: This 1-inch-long, copper mechanism magically coils around and clasps to the side of your ear, fitting as a functional ear cuff.

title: Clockwork Magic
detail: 1st-level Clockwork Soul feature You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Clockwork Spells table.

title: Clockwork Mend-A-Pillar
detail: This segmented mechanical caterpillar is 5 inches long, weighs 1 pound, and is made of copper.

title: Club of Dancing
detail: This metallic club emits prismatic flashes of light whenever it hits a target.

title: Club of the Forest Drake
detail: This wooden club's head has been naturally formed into the shape of a dragon's maw.

title: Club of the Rook
detail: This club is a magic weapon and has a weighty stone tower at its end.

title: Coat of Lies
detail: This coat made of the severed tongues of a harvester's victims provides a +1 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.

title: Coat of the Crest
detail: This exquisite brocade coat is cut in a long, high-collared style popular among nobles of the Clovis Concord—a nation on the west coast of Wildemount whose stylish fashion is often mimicked in Tal'Dorei.

title: College of Creation
detail: Bards believe the cosmos is a work of art-the creation of the first dragons and gods.

title: College of Spirits
detail: Bards of the College of Spirits seek tales with inherent power—be they legends, histories, or fictions—and bring their subjects to life.

title: College of Tragedy
detail: Not all grand stories conclude in triumphant victory.

title: Colossus Slayer
detail: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes.

title: Combat Inspiration
detail: Also at 3rd level, you learn to inspire others in battle.

title: Combat Superiority
detail: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called superiority dice.

title: Combat Wild Shape
detail: You gain the ability to use Wild Shape on your turn as a bonus action, rather than as an action.

title: Comet Ballista
detail: This crossbow is partially covered in cold shards of stone and metal and uses sling bullets as ammunition instead of crossbow bolts.

title: Comet Card
detail: As an action, you can hold this card aloft and call down a fiery meteor to a point you can see within 120 feet of yourself.

title: Comet Smasher Nunchaku
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Comet Smasher Three-Section Staff
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Command Undead
detail: Starting at 14th level, you can use magic to bring undead under your control, even those created by other wizards.

title: Common Glamerweave
detail: Glamerweave is clothing imbued with harmless illusory magic.

title: Composite Bow of Throne's Command
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Concealed Escape
detail: Concealed Escape (Reaction, 1/day): When you take damage or are targeted by an attack, you may become invisible until the start of your next turn and move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

title: Concertina
detail: A concertina is a less charming kind of accordion.

title: Conch of Teleportation
detail: This item is an ordinary, albeit rather large, conch shell that has been inscribed with the uvar rune.

title: Condemner
detail: This shadow-touched heavy crossbow once served as the weapon of choice for the legendary assassin Todora.

title: Condemner (Awakened)
detail: This shadow-touched heavy crossbow once served as the weapon of choice for the legendary assassin Todora.

title: Condemner (Dormant)

title: Elemental Surge
detail: Elemental Surge (Action, 1/day): Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, acid, or poison). Creatures within a 10-foot radius of a point you choose within 30 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus). On a failed save, they take 2d8 damage of the chosen type and suffer one of the following effects: - Fire: Target ignites, taking 1d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn. - Cold: Movement speed is reduced by 10 feet. - Lightning: Cannot take reactions until the end of their next turn. - Acid: Armor/shields take -1 penalty to AC. - Poison: Target is poisoned until end of next turn. Damage increases to 3d8 at 5th level, 4d8 at 11th, 5d8 at 17th.

title: Piercing Shot
detail: Piercing Shot (3/day): Before making an attack roll with a ranged weapon, you can activate Piercing Shot and choose a specific body part to target. On a hit, the target suffers a special effect based on the location struck: - Eyes – Target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight and on ranged attack rolls until the end of its next turn. - Arm/Hand – Target cannot wield two-handed weapons and may only hold a single object at a time until the end of its next turn. - Foot/Leg – Target’s movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn. - Torso – Target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 10 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) the next time it attempts an action. On a failed save, the target loses its action and reactions until the start of its next turn.

detail: Whirling Fury (1/day): When you hit a single target with multiple consecutive attacks, each hit deals +1 additional damage of the same type. This bonus resets if you miss or switch targets.

title: Whirlpool Dart
detail: This dart feels cold and hefty in the hand, but flies effortlessly when thrown.

title: Whirlwind Attack
detail: You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

title: Whispergust Mote
detail: A whispergust mote is a sentient breath of air typically separated from a larger air elemental.

title: Whispers of the Dead
detail: 3rd-level Phantom feature Echoes of those who have died cling to you.

title: White Chromatic Rose
detail: While this rose is held, it is covered in frost as a harmless visual effect.

title: White Dragon Scale Mail
detail: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon.

title: Wholeness of Body
detail: You gain the ability to heal yourself.

title: Wild Companion
detail: 2nd-level druid optional class features You gain the ability to summon a spirit that assumes an animal form: as an action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to cast the find familiar spell, without material components.

title: Wild Magic Surge
detail: Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic.

title: Wild Shape
detail: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before.

title: Wild Shape Improvement
detail: At 4th level, your Wild Shape improves as shown on the Beast Shapes table.

title: Wild Shape Improvement
detail: At 8th level, your Wild Shape improves as shown on the Beast Shapes table.

title: Wild Surge
detail: 3rd-level Path of Wild Magic feature The magical energy roiling inside you sometimes erupts from you.

title: Wildfire Ammunition
detail: This ammunition smolders while you hold it, sparking softly with simmering embers.

title: Will of the Talon (Awakened)
detail: Black, blue, green, red, and white gems carved in the form of dragon heads cover this ostentatious gold war pick, marking it as a weapon channeling the power of Tiamat.

title: Will of the Talon (Dormant)
detail: Black, blue, green, red, and white gems carved in the form of dragon heads cover this ostentatious gold war pick, marking it as a weapon channeling the power of Tiamat.

title: Will of the Talon (Exalted)
detail: Black, blue, green, red, and white gems carved in the form of dragon heads cover this ostentatious gold war pick, marking it as a weapon channeling the power of Tiamat.

title: Williwig's Time Stopper
detail: This magic bottle stopper's base is made of a mixture of cork and metal, but a stony, gargoyle figurine with a bored expression rests atop it.

title: Wind and Whirl
detail: This pair of scimitars was forged in the Elemental Plane of Air and cut effortlessly through the air in tandem.

title: Wind Fan
detail: While holding this fan, you can use an action to cast the gust of wind spell (save DC 13) from it.

title: Wind Riders
detail: These boots look and feel like pale, dried leaves but are remarkably soft and quiet to walk in.

title: Wind Soul
detail: At 18th level, you gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage.

title: Wind-Up Merchant
detail: This soft toy figurine is 5 inches tall and weighs 1 pound.

title: Wings of Flying
detail: While wearing this cloak, you can use an action to speak its command word.

title: Wings Unfurled
detail: 6th-level Way of the Ascendant Dragon feature When you use your Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral draconic wings from your back that vanish at the end of your turn.

title: Wingwear
detail: This snug uniform has symbols of air stitched into it and leathery flaps that stretch along the arms, waist, and legs to create wings for gliding.

title: Witchlight Scimitar
detail: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic scimitar's command word, causing golden radiance to spring from the blade.

title: Witchlight Vane
detail: This ornate rod is topped by a pair of butterfly wings and incorporates bits of red glass into its length.

title: Witchlight Watch
detail: This ornate pocket watch is fastened to the end of a gold chain.

title: Wizardly Quill
detail: 2nd-level Order of Scribes feature As a bonus action, you can magically create a Tiny quill in your free hand.

title: Wolf
detail: While you're raging, you can use a bonus action on your turn to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with melee weapon attack.

title: Wolfskin Cloak
detail: While wearing this cloak, as an action, you can assume the form of a dire wolf, gaining its bite attack, speed, and AC.

title: Wooden Cuirass of Fungal Spores
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Wooden Cuirass of Weightlessness
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Words of Terror
detail: At 3rd level, you learn to infuse innocent-seeming words with an insidious magic that can inspire terror.

title: Wraps of Dyamak (Awakened)
detail: Created and wielded by the ancient warrior-monk Dyamak, these thick strips of enchanted cloth are stained to appear dark crimson with blood of unknown origin.

title: Wraps of Dyamak (Exalted)
detail: Created and wielded by the ancient warrior-monk Dyamak, these thick strips of enchanted cloth are stained to appear dark crimson with blood of unknown origin.

title: Wraps of the Restless
detail: These salvaged wrappings from the arms of a mummy lord hang loosely from your arms but never seem to slide off.

title: Wrath of the Storm
detail: Also at 1st level, you can thunderously rebuke attackers.

title: Writhing Tide
detail: 7th-level Swarmkeeper feature You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up.

title: Wrought-Iron Tower
detail: Constructed from the same materials as his tower, Dispater's Wrought-Iron Tower is a powerful weapon that marks his rule over Dis.

title: Wyllow's Staff of Flowers
detail: This wooden staff has 10 charges.

title: Wyrmling Wristlet
detail: This bracelet has 1d6 + 3 colorful, egg-shaped beads hanging from it.

title: Wyrmreaver Gauntlets
detail: Originally crafted for ground-bound giant brawlers to fight against dragons and other enormous predators of the sky, these studded gauntlets are engraved with the dragon rune.

title: Wyrmshide Bow
detail: This bow is crafted with delicate dragon scales and strung with a fiber from a dragon's heart.

title: Wyrmskull Throne
detail: Built by dwarven gods and entrusted to the rulers of Shanatar, an ancient dwarven empire.

title: Xibalban Blade
detail: This toothed obsidian blade absorbs any blood that's left on it.

title: Xorn-Sole Boots
detail: This pair of iron-toed boots is made with the rocky leather hide of a xorn.

title: Yellow Harbinger's Metal Cuirass
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Yellow Harbinger's Path
detail: This burnt yellow armor is the mark of a royal scout.

detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Yellow Harbinger's Spiked Armor
detail: The base item can be found in Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide, page 121.

title: Yellow Harbinger's Wooden Cuirass
detail: The base item can be found in Armour, Items, and Weapons Galore.

title: Yklwa Armblade
detail: The base item can be found in Tomb of Annihilation, page 32.

title: Yklwa of Verdict
detail: The base item can be found in Tomb of Annihilation, page 32.

title: Ythryn Mythallar
detail: A mythallar looks like an enormous crystal ball held in an ornate cradle.

title: Zeal
detail: The steel head of this warhammer seems to glow with an inner light.

title: Zealous Presence
detail: At 10th level, you learn to channel divine power to inspire zealotry in others.

title: Zephyr Armor
detail: This fine set of white-and-silver armor bears the wind rune upon its chest.
